title: Product Review: Lattafa Fakhar Eau de Parfum (#TracyAWillis)
description:
Lattafa Fakhar for Women

The perfume is Light and Fruity.

Top Notes: Bergamot, Lily, & Pomegranate

Middle Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Honeysuckle, Tuberose, Peony, & Gardenia

Base Notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Ambroxan, & White Musk

This enchanting and sensual fragrance envelops its wearer in a cloud of florals and delicious notes.
